source.table_or_page: Petroleum and other liquids; Natural gas

notes: Oil: no country line in OPEC ASB or EI ('Other Africa'). EIA: total liquids ~108 kb/d in 2023 of which <1% crude+lease condensate (nearly all synthetic CTL/GTL fuels); PetroSA F-A offshore field and Mossel Bay GTL in care & maintenance since 2020. A negligible (<1 kb/d) but non-zero crude/condensate stream cannot be quantified -> null. Gas: EIA gives only a 2014-2023 average (~27 bcf/yr = ~765 million m3), no year-specific value -> null.
